name: ai.carfinity/marketplace
title: Carfinity car marketplace
description: Search new and used cars at US dealers, each ranked against its local market price.

tools.name: search_cars
tools.description: Search new and used cars for sale at local dealers, in plain language. Every car comes back with its advertised price, its market price, how far under or over market it is, a deal label, a 0 to 100 score and its rank among comparable cars. Use a market name in the query or the market argument. Returns up to 10 cars per call, best deals first.

query.description: What the shopper wants, in their words. Examples: 'used SUV under $30k AWD', 'new Honda CR-V', 'certified Toyota under 40,000 miles', 'something cheap on gas for commuting'.

market.description: Market slug from list_markets, for example 'dallas-tx'. Optional if the query names the city.

tools.name: get_car
tools.description: Full details of one car: price against its market price, why it ranks where it does in plain sentences, mileage, color, drivetrain, photos count, the dealer and its phone, and the page to open. Use the id from search_cars.

car_id.description: The 12-character id of the car, or its Carfinity URL.

tools.name: compare_cars
tools.description: Compare 2 to 4 cars side by side on price, market price, percent under market, score, rank, mileage and dealer, and say which is the best deal.

tools.name: market_summary
tools.description: How many of a model (or kind of car) are for sale in a market, the median advertised price and mileage, the price range, and the share priced under market. Use it for questions like 'what does a used Camry cost in Dallas' or 'is now a good time'.

query.description: A model or kind of car, with new or used, for example 'used Toyota Camry', 'new Ford F-150', 'used SUV under $30k'.

market.description: Market slug from list_markets. Optional if the query names the city.

tools.name: dealer_info
tools.description: A dealer's name, address, phone and website, how many new and used cars it has listed, and its best-ranked cars.

market.description: Market slug, to narrow a common name.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: The markets Carfinity covers, with the number of cars in each.

tools.name: best_deals
tools.description: The best-ranked car deals in one market right now: the top deals overall, then SUVs, trucks, sedans, hybrids and cars under $20,000. Each car comes with its price, how far under its market price it is, and its link. Use it for 'what are the best car deals in Pittsburgh' or 'best used car deals near Dallas'.

market.description: Market slug from list_markets, for example 'pittsburgh-pa'.

condition.description: Only new or only used cars. Leave out for both.

tools.name: buyer_research
tools.description: Carfinity's research for car buyers, from today's dealer inventory. Topic 'best_new_cars': the new models with the biggest discounts off sticker price this month, for the whole country or one market. Topic 'best_states': every state ranked by what the same new models cost there against the national average. Quote the figures with the month and link the page given.

market.description: Market slug, for best_new_cars in one market. Leave out for the whole country.

tools.name: draft_dealer_message
tools.description: Draft a message to the dealer about one car for the shopper to review: it asks about availability, the out-the-door price with fees, add-ons and history. Returns the draft text only. Nothing is sent to the dealer. Ask the shopper before calling this, and use only the name and contact they gave you.

first_name.description: The shopper's first name, as they gave it.

contact.description: Email or mobile number the shopper wants answers sent to, as they gave it.

questions.description: What to ask. Default: availability and out-the-door price.

note.description: Anything else the shopper wants asked, in their words.
